# git: push: avoid fork-*

Stop `push` from pushing to remotes that the author cannot write to. **Motivation:** "forks are unavailable to pushing" — with a `fork-<owner>` remote added to follow someone's fork, `push` (which pushes to every remote except `upstream`) failed:

```bash
$ push
To github.com:DimovyM/web-tact.git
 ! [remote rejected] main -> main (permission denied)
 ! [remote rejected] v0.0.1 -> v0.0.1 (permission denied)
 ...
error: failed to push some refs to 'github.com:DimovyM/web-tact.git'
```

The better way is to exclude forks from the push by their naming convention.
